title: Sr Front-end Engineer - LATAM Core (100% Remote)
description:
About the job

Join the Commerce team at Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) , the engine powering the travel portals for the world’s most iconic brands like Capital One, Air Canada, and Uber. HTS now represents over 85% of Hopper’s business , reaching over 400 million travelers globally. We aren't just building apps; we are architecting a high‑scale, white‑label commerce platform that processes billions of dollars in travel and fintech annually .

We are looking for a high‑ownership Frontend Engineer to help us redefine B2B travel. At HTS, we thrive on a bottom‑up innovation culture . We don't wait for top‑down mandates; our engineers have the autonomy to identify performance levers, propose new product capabilities, and ship features that move the needle for our global partners. If you love a fast‑paced environment where your code directly impacts millions of users from day one, you belong here.

What would your day‑to‑day look like

  • Design & Build at Scale: Architect and review code for world‑class, multi‑tenant travel portals that balance reusable white‑label foundations with partner‑specific customizations.

  • Autonomous Execution: Lead initiatives from concept to deployment. Our group operates with a low‑meeting culture , emphasizing deep work, strong alignment, and asynchronous decision‑making to maximize engineering velocity.

  • Product Innovation: Collaborate side‑by‑side with Product Managers and Designers to explore engineering improvements that enhance the user experience and drive partner growth.

  • Cross‑Functional Impact: Work seamlessly across Hopper’s ecosystem—integrating with our Scala‑based fintech services and GCP infrastructure to bring sophisticated travel features to market.

An ideal candidate has

  • Exceptional Technical Craft: Expert‑level proficiency in React and TypeScript , with a deep understanding of component architecture, state management, and web performance.

  • Product‑Minded Engineering: You anchor your conception of "quality" in the customer experience and understand how to translate business ambiguity into clear, scalable code.

  • Iterative DNA: A natural drive to deliver results fast. You know how to distinguish between "must‑be‑perfect" core logic and features that can be evolved through data‑driven iteration.

  • Systems Thinking: Experience (or a hunger to learn) managing complex frontends within a distributed systems environment, ensuring reliability for high‑stakes partner integrations.

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short‑term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

  • The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

  • While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

  • Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

  • Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.
  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.
  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.
  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  • Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.
  • Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.
  • Come take off with us!

O Mecânico de Refrigeração é responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e climatização, como ar-condicionado, câmaras frigoríficas, freezers e outros equipamentos similares. Este profissional assegura o funcionamento eficiente e seguro dos sistemas de refrigeração, realizando diagnósticos, trocas de componentes e ajustes técnicos necessários para manter os ambientes adequadamente refrigerados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a instalação de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado em ambientes comerciais, industriais e residenciais, seguindo as normas técnicas e de segurança.
  • Executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos de refrigeração, identificando problemas, realizando ajustes, substituição de peças e limpeza de componentes para garantir o desempenho ideal.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de refrigeração para detectar falhas, vazamentos de gás, problemas elétricos e mecânicos, utilizando ferramentas específicas para diagnósticos precisos.
  • Realizar reparos em compressores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão e demais componentes dos sistemas de refrigeração, garantindo a restauração completa do equipamento.
  • Realizar a carga e recarga de gás refrigerante nos sistemas, conforme as especificações técnicas e normas ambientais.
  • Testar e ajustar os equipamentos após a instalação ou reparo, verificando a temperatura, pressão, fluxo de ar e outros parâmetros para assegurar o funcionamento correto.
  • Preencher relatórios de serviços realizados, registrando as atividades de manutenção, peças substituídas e recomendações para futuras intervenções.
  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no trabalho, utilizando os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) e adotando práticas seguras durante a execução das tarefas.
  • Prestar suporte técnico aos clientes, orientando sobre o uso correto dos equipamentos e explicando as intervenções realizadas.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso técnico ou profissionalizante em Refrigeração e Climatização.
  • Experiência comprovada na instalação, manutenção e reparo de sistemas de refrigeração e ar-condicionado.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos e mecânicos de refrigeração.
  • Habilidade para realizar diagnósticos de falhas e executar reparos em componentes complexos.
  • Carteira de habilitação (Categoria B) pode ser exigida para deslocamento até os locais de serviço.

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Role Purpose

We are seeking a senior Regulatory Affairs & Product Certification Manager to act as the single owner and authority for all Anatel regulatory compliance and product certification activities in Brazil.

This role is critical to ensuring the company’s ability to import, commercialize, deploy, and operate telecommunications products in the Brazilian market, while enabling speed-to-market, commercial competitiveness, and long-term regulatory sustainability.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, strong interaction with Global HQ, and direct influence on revenue, deployment, and customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the full lifecycle of Anatel homologation and product certification activities, including planning, execution, publication, maintenance, renewals, and amendments.
  • Act as the single point of accountability with Anatel, OCDs (Designated Certification Bodies), and accredited laboratories.
  • Define and execute regulatory strategies per product family, balancing compliance, cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and time-to-market.
  • Coordinate and validate all regulatory and technical documentation, including test reports, declarations of conformity, manuals in Portuguese, and technical files.
  • Assess the regulatory impact of hardware, firmware, RF, and configuration changes, enforcing regulatory gates and blocking deployments when compliance is at risk.
  • Ensure strict alignment between certified configurations and field-deployed products, SKUs, and software versions.
  • Support Sales, Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Supply Chain with regulatory validation for RFPs, RFQs, imports, and network deployments.
  • Maintain an audit-ready regulatory repository and manage interactions with Anatel during audits, inspections, and formal inquiries.
  • Monitor homologation validity dates and proactively manage renewals to prevent service disruption or import blocks.
  • Continuously improve certification lead time, cost efficiency, and regulatory predictability through optimization strategies.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Interface directly with Global Regulatory Affairs,, Product Engineering, Test & Certification, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial teams.
  • Translate global product roadmaps and engineering changes into Brazilian regulatory requirements and execution plans.
  • Act as the internal regulatory authority and trusted advisor on Brazilian telecommunications regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in regulatory affairs, product certification, or compliance within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Anatel homologation processes, especially for Class III (network infrastructure) equipment.
  • Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, EMC, electrical safety, and telecom network technologies (RAN, MW, IP, Optical, CPE).
  • English as primary working language is mandatory; Portuguese fluency is required; Advanced Mandarin is desirable.
  • Ability to operate autonomously with strong ownership, sound judgment, and assertive decision-making.

What Success Looks Like

Zero expired or non-compliant homologations.

No import blocks or deployment delays caused by regulatory issues.

Reduced certification lead time and re-test costs.

Full regulatory visibility and predictability for leadership, engineering, and sales.

Recognition as the internal authority on Anatel and Brazilian telecom regulation.

Why This Role Matters

This is strategic, technical, and business-critical role when you can face challenge and develop yourself.

Without regulatory compliance, products do not enter the country and networks do not go live.

With strong regulatory leadership, the company operates faster, safer, and more competitively in Brazil.

Are you interested in being part of our team?

Please apply for this opportunity and attach your resume in English. Kindly note that only English resumes will be considered.

title: Senior Product Manager – Workflow Platforms
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help scale and evolve a clinician-facing internal platform that directly supports the daily work of thousands of healthcare professionals. This platform is mission‑critical to care delivery operations, powering scheduling workflows, clinician experience, operational processes, data insights, and adherence to quality standards.

In this role, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy and hands‑on execution. You will own a defined product area, drive delivery against the roadmap, and lead discovery for initiatives that improve clinician workflows, care quality, and operational efficiency. While the platform is primarily used internally, its impact is highly visible and measurable, directly influencing patient outcomes, clinician satisfaction, and business performance.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and clinical stakeholders to translate real‑world operational needs into scalable, reliable product solutions. This role is ideal for a Product Manager who thrives in workflow‑heavy environments, enjoys tackling complex systems, and is motivated by building tools that make a meaningful difference in how care is delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver product initiatives that improve clinician workflows and care delivery performance
  • Collaborate closely with clinical and operational stakeholders to ensure solutions fit real‑world needs
  • Lead discovery efforts: identify pain points, validate solutions, and define measurable success metrics
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to prioritize and execute against the product roadmap
  • Support day‑to‑day execution with engineering teams (standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, QA, launch readiness)
  • Define success metrics and align teams on measurable outcomes for product initiatives
  • Ensure high product quality through strong product hygiene (acceptance criteria, edge cases, release management, post‑launch monitoring)
  • Use data to guide decisions, measure impact, and iterate after launch
  • Help establish repeatable processes for balancing roadmap work with bug fixes and support requests

Must Have

  • 4+ years of experience in Product Management, owning product delivery and outcomes
  • Experience building workflow‑heavy products (internal tools, platforms, enterprise or operational systems)
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to align cross‑functional teams
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and drive execution
  • Comfort using data to prioritise work, evaluate performance, and influence decisions
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and create clarity

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioural health, clinical operations, or regulated environments
  • Experience building clinician‑facing tools, EMR‑related workflows, or operational platforms
  • Experience building or scaling integrations with third‑party systems (APIs, data pipelines, event‑driven systems)

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.

  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.

Our Values

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

Company Overview

Core Laboratories is the Reservoir Optimization Company. Core Laboratories Inc. is a leading provider of proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services and products used to optimize petroleum reservoir performance. The Company has over 70 offices in more than 50 countries and is located in every major oil‑producing province in the world. We are well‑positioned to serve the growing needs of the energy transition while continuing to fulfill the demand for reliable and affordable energy sources like crude oil and natural gas. Our services, products, expertise, and innovations will continue to be essential as our clients meet the growing demand for energy globally. At Core Lab, our values matter: Safety, Honesty and Integrity, Customer Focus, Building Trust, and Employee Development. We regard our employees as our greatest asset and believe that identifying, attracting, developing, and retaining talent are significant actions because our people are so important.

Summary

Press, assemble and pack shaped charges using components provided according to written work instructions.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Determine correct components to be used during the pressing process against written work instructions and engineering data sheets.
  • Transfer cases from pallet to dolly and charges from press area to the test area.
  • Transfer explosive powder bins from refill area to work area.
  • Operate press lever and slide dies on press table.
  • Conduct visual in‑process inspection on manufactured components.
  • Utilize tools to cut bands on pallets and scoop mixing powders.
  • Load components with explosive powders.
  • Weigh explosive load to be pressed and placed into components.
  • Complete necessary production and quality control paperwork at the end of each shift.
  • Maintain clean work area.
  • Assemble components according to written instructions.
  • Conduct visual process inspection on components being assembled.
  • Report problems to shift supervisor.
  • Pack completed products according to work instructions.
  • Willingness and ability to follow instructions.
  • Work overtime when necessary.
  • Work on a team.
  • Transport, stack and paint liners.
  • Wear 100% cotton clothing (detonators only).
  • Other duties as required.

Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes

  • Ability to follow instructions.
  • Ability to listen carefully.
  • Ability to perform intricate hand assembly.
  • Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk and hear. The employee must regularly lift and/or move, with help, up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and depth perception. Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment including: safety glasses, hearing protection, powdered latex gloves, respirator (must pass respirator test) and/or dust mask, steel toe shoes.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics include exposure to moving mechanical parts, fumes or airborne particles, and explosive materials. The employee may also be exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level is usually moderately loud; hearing protection is required.

description:
Senior Manager, Catering

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) will take place in June and July 2027, across eight stadiums in Brazil.

Reporting to the Head of Venue Operations, the Senior Catering Manager is responsible for the efficient organization of catering operations for FWWC2027 and all competition‑related events. This includes catering services at competition and non‑competition venues for multiple client groups such as workforce, media, broadcast, teams, match officials, ceremonies, and youth programmes, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

The Senior Catering Manager will act as the first point of contact for all key deliverables related to catering services within venues, including sustainability, hygiene, kitchen equipment, space allocation, venue operations, etc. The role ensures consistency of in‑venue catering across the tournament, meeting agreed quality standards at all venues.

This position requires effective and efficient management of catering operations, seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, problem‑solving, innovation, issue escalation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and execute catering operations for multiple client groups during the FWWC and its competition‑related events
  • Develop and coordinate catering service concepts aligned with client expectations and service levels.
  • Establish working relationships with key stakeholders, including public authorities such as ANVISA.
  • Produce technical specifications for catering requirements, equipment, and spaces to provide the required service at competition and no competition venues
  • Conduct full inventory of catering spaces and kitchen equipment at each venue and assign them per FIFA requirements.
  • Define strategic, operational, and technical requirements for catering tenders and procurement procedures to select catering for each stadium and any other relevant sites.
  • Provide operational input to the catering budget and oversee its execution.
  • Ensure project budgeting, reporting, and post‑event debriefing for catering operations
  • Work closely with appointed venue caterers, FIFA functional areas, and stakeholders to ensure high‑quality catering services
  • Negotiate measurable KPIs with caterers and ensure menu options are tested and meet quality standards for all user groups.
  • Oversee food safety and quality assurance of catering operations across all venues.
  • Integrate catering operational plans into overall venue plans.
  • Identify and mitigate risks across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years delivering catering services at international sporting events.
  • Proven strong record of experience in organising catering services for complex events involving multiple venues, stakeholders and authorities.
  • Strong knowledge of local food and beverage regulations, including food safety standards applicable to sporting events.
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes.
  • Excellent customer service experience, with references for excellence.
  • High level of presentation and negotiating skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead teams without formal reporting structure
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large‑scale events.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset
  • Flexibility when faced with ambiguity or constant change
  • Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player with ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Solution‑oriented mindset with resilience and positivity under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage high workloads during peak periods.
  • Sound judgment and critical problem‑solving skills.
  • Effective leadership, motivational, and negotiation skills.
  • High energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Cultural awareness and sensitivity, with experience in international contexts.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados deverão abranger toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde está preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia;

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista.

  • Step 3: Avaliação comportamental - Gestão de pessoas 3 Avaliação comportamental - Gestão de pessoas

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêitos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Arquiteto(a) de Dados Sr
description:
Job description

A área de Arquitetura de Dados é responsável por definir visão, princípios, padrões e desenho de soluções para que a organização tenha dados confiáveis, seguros, bem catalogados e interoperáveis, habilitando analytics e IA com escalabilidade e eficiência. Atua como agente de transformação, estruturando uma plataforma resiliente, promovendo democratização com controle, e consolidando uma cultura orientada a dados e governança. Missão da Vaga Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados corporativa (plataforma, integração, modelagem, metadados e governança), garantindo coerência técnica, qualidade, segurança, conformidade e eficiência de custos (FinOps). Conduzir decisões arquiteturais com stakeholders, estabelecer padrões e guiar times na implementação de soluções que sustentem dados e IA em escala.

Main responsibilities

  • Definir arquiteturas-alvo para Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, streaming e integrações (batch/real-time), alinhadas à estratégia do negócio;
  • Estabelecer padrões, blueprints e guidelines (nomenclatura, particionamento, versionamento, camadas, contratos de dados, SLAs/SLOs);
  • Liderar revisões arquiteturais (architecture reviews), garantindo aderência a padrões, segurança e governança;
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos;
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração;
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos;
  • Desenhar e operacionalizar governança: domínios, ownership (data owner/steward), política de acesso, classificação de dados, LGPD, retenção e trilhas de auditoria;
  • Implantar e evoluir metadados e catálogo, linhagem (lineage), glossário de negócio e dicionário técnico;
  • Definir e monitorar controles de qualidade (regras, thresholds, reconciliações), com gestão de incidentes e indicadores;
  • Orientar escolhas de serviços e desenho em nuvem, garantindo segurança by design (IAM, KMS/Secret Manager, criptografia, segregação);
  • Definir observabilidade de dados: monitoramento, alertas, tracing, dashboards, governança de pipelines e disponibilidade.

Requirements and skills

Formação e experiência

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz(tableau, power bi e/ou looker);
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.

Conhecimentos técnicos

  • Cloud & Data Platform: experiência com GCP (BigQuery, Composer/Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run/Functions, KMS/Secret Manager, Datastream, GitHub) e/ou Azure (ADF, Synapse, ADLS);
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Arquitetura de integração: batch, streaming, CDC, APIs; desenho de camadas e padrões de ingestão/transformação/consumo;
  • Modelagem de dados: dimensional, relacional, data vault (se aplicável), modelagem para analytics/BI e camada semântica;
  • Governança & Segurança: classificação e controle de acesso, LGPD, criptografia, políticas e auditoria, catálogo/linhagem/metadados;
  • DataOps/DevOps: CI/CD, testes de dados, versionamento, automação e boas práticas de operação;
  • Performance & custo: otimização de consultas, particionamento, clustering, tuning e práticas de FinOps;
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados);
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados;

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Business Development Manager to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people‑led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Business Development Manager acts as the key link between the company’s product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject‑matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision‑making.
  • Provide data‑driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go‑to‑market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with distributors, partners, and end‑user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field‑based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance‑based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high‑growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long‑term career progression.

title: mbar Energia - Mecânico de Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Job description


Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.


Temos 50 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e o biogás.


Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.


Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.


Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.


Main responsibilities



  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de forma segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;

  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;

  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;

  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;

  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;

  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;

  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;

  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potenciais impactos ambientais.


Requirements and skills



  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;

  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas térmicas;

  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;

  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);

  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);

  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);

  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;

  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;

  • Conhecimento em Hidráulica e Pneumática;

  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;

  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;

  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;

  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;

  • Interpretação de Desenho Mecânico.

title: Project Manager, Nature Fund Advisory
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA, Colombia, Peru, or Brazil. This role offers remote or hybrid work flexibility.

Amid growing consensus that the protection, restoration, and improved management of ecosystems can provide at least 30% of the climate mitigation needed to limit warming to 1.5°C, Conservation International (CI) has set ambitious targets to realize the potential of Natural Climate Solutions (NCS) worldwide. CI's Carbon Finance (CF) unit within the Nature Finance Group (NFG) invests in Natural Climate Solutions that help combat climate change by reducing deforestation and conserving critical ecosystem services. These NCS solutions include the protection, enhanced management, and restoration of forests, rangelands, wetlands, and other natural systems.

The Nature Fund Advisory team acts as impact advisors to private and public investors looking to deploy return‑seeking capital into NCS projects in ways that deliver tangible climate, community, and ecological outcomes. The team works to establish ESG and impact criteria for these investment vehicles, conducts due diligence on potential investments, and carries out annual impact monitoring for our client partners. The team taps the deep knowledge and technical expertise within CI to catalyze and improve the quality of gigatons of emission reductions in the voluntary and compliance carbon markets.

This position is an integral part of the Nature Fund Advisory team. The Project Manager will have two core responsibilities: (A) overall project management of the Nature Fund Advisory workflow and (B) distillations of lessons learned and best practices identified from the projects CI due diligence and management of that information in an associated database. The first responsibility includes project and budget planning, implementation, tracking, and reporting on deliverables and project status. The Project Manager will ensure project results meet project standards, and project deliverables are completed on time and within budget. The second responsibility focuses on creating and maintaining a knowledge management database and template system that will record relevant information extracted from due diligence reports into a format that is accessible by the rest of the institution for ongoing learning and development.

This position does not directly supervise staff.

Responsibilities

  • Provide project management support of Nature Fund Advisory tasks, which generally fall into ESG and Impact criteria establishment, due diligence, and annual monitoring and evaluation.
  • Ensure final reports are consistent in formatting, language, and results by weaving together the different writing styles and technical frameworks used to create final drafts.
  • Help oversee the progress of projects to ensure they stay on track, on time, and within budget.
  • Draft summary reports on each project and create and maintain a knowledge management database to help extract learnings.
  • Identify trends and corrective actions to resolve problems and ensure future project efficiency and success.
  • Prepare high‑quality status updates, reports, and presentations for senior management and donors, and ensure project and team information is accurately updated on the Nature Fund Advisory SharePoint.
  • Support due diligence site visit planning.
  • Create and maintain project files.
  • Ensure compliance with CI policies, funding agreements, and local requirements.

Working Conditions

  • This is a full‑time position.
  • Travel within the region will consist of approximately 10‑15% of the person’s time, often to remote locations and in difficult travel and working conditions.
  • Flexibility in work schedule required to accommodate time‑zone differences between the Arlington, VA office, and international field offices located in Europe, Asia‑Pacific, Africa, and Latin America.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a natural resource management‑related field or another relevant discipline.
  • Experience and understanding of Natural Climate Solutions or conservation projects.
  • 4 to 6 years or more of relevant work experience.
  • Excellent project management and organization skills, and a strong attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with project management software (Monday.com, Asana, etc.).
  • Experience working with partners in the Global South, with an understanding of the on‑the‑ground realities and challenges of project development and delivery.
  • Demonstrated problem‑solving skills and ability to build on existing knowledge to develop new approaches.
  • Proven team player and able to work effectively with diverse work groups in a multicultural environment.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; Proficient in written and spoken English.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, multitask, set priorities, and deliver quality results.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced environment with changing priorities and under general supervision.

Preferred

  • Ability to communicate in Spanish, Portuguese, or French.
  • Knowledge and expertise in environmental markets, especially in voluntary carbon markets. Experience with analysis, structuring, and valuation of natural resources and/or other investments.
  • Understanding of the economic and environmental issues facing developing countries and the local communities.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

InPlanet is a mission‑driven, remote‑first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO₂ while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders – and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil – where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Financial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care of Accounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You'll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically – structured, purpose‑driven, and comfortable switching between hands‑on tasks and higher‑level discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS

  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash‑flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3‑5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards, IFRS, and multi‑entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR), and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Key Qualities

  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn

  • Hard‑working and hands‑on
  • Detail‑oriented and analytical, with a problem‑solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross‑functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross‑border or fast‑growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. title: Onboarding Manager (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , MonetizeMore focuses on proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals. You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts—you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. 2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher\'s specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. 3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-to-day Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don\'t just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers\' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves:

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have:

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

description:
No Grupo S2 , somos pioneiros em desenvolver marcas e produtos icônicos de footwear e lifestyle que se conectam com o agora. Nosso propósito é encantar o consumidor e marcar histórias .

A Redley , marca urbana que traduz liberdade, atitude e estilo de vida. Estar no time da Redley é uma oportunidade única para mergulhar no nosso universo e viver de perto a energia da nossa ALMA SOLAR .

Existimos para marcar histórias — venha viver a sua com a gente!

Missão da vaga:

Criar peças gráficas e desenvolver projetos de média complexidade que traduzam a identidade visual da marca REDLEY com excelência técnica e criativa. Responsável por desdobrar campanhas, desenvolver identidades de produto, criar estampas e produzir materiais gráficos que suportem as estratégias de marketing, produto e varejo. Atuar sob supervisão da coordenação, garantindo qualidade de execução e prazos.

  • Criar peças gráficas e desenvolver projetos de média complexidade com acompanhamento da coordenação.
  • Desdobrar Key Visuals de campanhas e eventos para diferentes formatos e plataformas.
  • Desenvolver identidades visuais para produtos, incluindo aviamentos e embalagens.
  • Produzir apresentações visuais para uso comercial e comunicação interna.
  • Desenvolver estampas, coloração e fechamento técnico de arquivos para produção.
  • Produzir material gráfico de suporte ao Estilo (painéis, moodboards, fichas técnicas).
  • Aplicar identidades de marca nas demandas diárias (e-commerce, visual merchandising, mídias digitais).

Ensino Superior completo em Desenho Industrial, Design Gráfico, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas. Domínio do pacote Adobe (especialmente Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, InDesign). Conhecimento para saída de arquivos e preparação para diferentes processos produtivos. Repertório gráfico e visual relativo ao universo da marca.

  • Day Off no Aniversário – seu dia é para ser celebrado do jeito que você merece!
  • Vale-Transporte – garantimos a sua mobilidade até o trabalho
  • Vale Refeição de R$ 40,00 reais o dia/útil
  • Modelo Trabalho Híbrido

Acreditamos que mais do que vestir, as roupas nos ajudam a contar histórias. Aqui contamos histórias sobre pessoas de Alma Solar, que aproveitam cada momento da Vida, que transmitem boas energias. Pessoas que não se contentam com a rotina e deixam os dias mais leves, como um mergulho no mar, um rolé de skate, um passeio de bike.

Há 40 anos buscamos entender o espírito do nosso tempo e de cada tempo, conectados com o mundo e com a natureza ao nosso redor.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável por realizar a gestão do processo de compras de materiais, garantindo o abastecimento das áreas internas com qualidade, prazo e custo adequados.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. Com mais de 60 anos de história, estamos sempre em busca de inovação e sustentabilidade, oferecendo soluções diferenciadas no setor imobiliário. Valorizamos o potencial das pessoas e acreditamos que, juntos, podemos construir um futuro melhor. Se você é apaixonado por transformar, colaborar e fazer a diferença, venha fazer parte do impossível, que para nós não é só um ponto de vista, e sim um ponto de partida.

Programa de Desenvolvimento Acelerado de Estágio - PDA da RJZ Cyrela

  • Job Rotation no escritório entre as áreas do Administrativo Financeiro, Incorporação e Novos Negócios/Terrenos. Sendo do Administrativo Financeiro: Backoffice de Vendas, Cobrança, Controladoria, Registro e Repasse; nos times de Incorporação RJZ Cyrela, Living e Vivaz, e no time de Novos Negócios/Terrenos. No Financeiro o job rotation preferencialmente é feito a cada 6 meses, e no time de Incorporação após 12 meses pela estrutura do ciclo do negócio para que você consiga entender toda a esteira do negócio e no time de Terrenos geralmente após 1 ao e meio pela estrutura do ciclo do negócio. O seu job rotation pode começar em uma dessas áreas e depois rodar, ela varia conforme as oportunidades internas e seu perfil. A rotação em diversas áreas lhe possibilita tornar um profissional mais capacitado e com diversos conhecimentos sobre as atividades da empresa. Além disso terá acompanhamento de resolução de projetos e apadrinhamento. Valorizamos seu jeito de ser e de pensar. Acreditamos e investimos no seu potencial!
  • Apadrinhamento: a relação entre padrinho/madrinha e estagiário é uma via de mão dupla que colabora para ambas as partes e a organização. É um investimento de tempo e esforço que produz frutos duradouros, moldando não apenas carreiras, mas também vidas. Nossos padrinhos/madrinhas escolhidos para o PDA, estão preparados para reconhecer o potencial do outro e trabalhar ativamente para realizá-lo.
  • Trilha de formação: com o objetivo de impulsionar o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal, além de fortalecer a formação dentro da Companhia, contamos com um cronograma anual focado no aprimoramento de soft e hard skills. A programação inclui visitas às obras, encontros "Café com Carreira" com ex-estagiários que hoje ocupam posições de liderança e na Diretoria, projetos colaborativos com desafios reais da Companhia, entre outras ações especiais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que espera por você no seu dia a dia:

No time do Financeiro

  • Verificação e acompanhamento do fluxo de caixa e viabilidade dos empreendimentos;
  • Elaboração e análise de relatórios de performance de processos;
  • Análise de crédito e aprovação de proposta de vendas;
  • Gerenciamento do estoque de imóveis à venda;
  • Controle da base de dados relacionados às áreas do financeiro;
  • Melhoria de processos.

No time de Novos Negócios/Terrenos

  • Auxiliar na avaliação dos terrenos de acordo com os interesses da empresa;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração do estudo de viabilidade econômica do terreno apurando a rentabilidade do negócio, com o objetivo de subsidiar a empresa com informações para tomada de decisão;
  • Acompanhar serviços técnicos necessários antes da compra do terreno.

No time de Incorporação

  • Auxiliar na elaborar os estudos de viabilidade de lançamento, com base na análise e otimização dos projetos do produto, interagindo com as áreas de desenvolvimento de produto e projeto legal, visando manter a rentabilidade projetada na compra do terreno;
